verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli, verified reachable via probe) explicitly built for AI-native use: OAuth login, `--agent` flag for JSON output for scripting/agent consumption, `--no-input` for CI, client-credentials auth for standalone agents, profile switching between human/agent identities, and broad resource coverage (bills, cards, transactions, reimbursements, travel, purchase-orders, etc.). Docs (build-for-ai-agents.txt, README) and agents.ramp.com corroborate this as a first-class agentic channel alongside MCP. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the CLI itself (only vendor docs and a reachability probe, no third-party review of the CLI experience).
